content.value_statement: Brand styling can drift across slides, documents, and visual artifacts. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a compact Anthropic style reference.
actual_capabilities: Lists Anthropic main and accent color values.
Defines heading and body font choices with fallbacks.
Guides text color selection based on background.
Describes accent color use for non-text shapes.
Explains PowerPoint color application through python-pptx RGBColor.
Provides font fallback guidance for Poppins and Lora.
limitations: Does not install fonts or verify local font availability.
Does not include logo files or complete legal brand usage rules.
Does not modify files unless the host assistant applies the guidance.
Focuses on Anthropic styling, not general brand strategy.

use_cases.title: Restyle Presentation Slides
use_cases.description: Apply approved colors, heading fonts, body fonts, and accents to a slide deck.

use_cases.title: Align Generated Documents
use_cases.description: Guide document styling so reports and briefs match Anthropic visual identity.

use_cases.title: Implement Brand-Aware UI Details
use_cases.description: Use the color palette and typography rules when refining product mockups or interface examples.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Basic Styling
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple artifact.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Anthropic brand guidelines from this skill to my artifact. Use the listed colors, heading fonts, body fonts, and accent rules.

prompt_templates.title: Restyle a Slide Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this slide deck and update its visual styling with Anthropic colors and typography. Preserve readability, hierarchy, and slide intent.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Brand Consistency
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this design for consistency with the skill guidelines. Identify color, typography, contrast, and accent usage issues with concise fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Implementation Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a step-by-step plan to apply these brand guidelines across a document set. Include colors, typography, accents, and review checks.

output_examples.input: Restyle a product overview slide deck.
output_examples.output: Headings use Poppins with dark text. Body copy uses Lora. Light backgrounds use the approved neutral color. Accent shapes rotate orange, blue, and green.

output_examples.input: Review a one-page report for brand fit.
output_examples.output: The report uses the right neutral palette, but headings need Poppins. Replace saturated purple accents with the approved orange and blue.

output_examples.input: Prepare UI notes for a branded mockup.
output_examples.output: Use dark text on light backgrounds, reserve orange for primary accents, and use blue or green for secondary visual emphasis.

best_practices: Provide the artifact type and target format before asking for styling changes.
Install Poppins and Lora when exact typography matters.
Check contrast after applying brand colors to text and backgrounds.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the palette as a full legal brand policy.
Do not use accent colors for dense body text.
Do not assume custom fonts are available on every system.

faq.question: What does this skill help style?
faq.answer: It helps style slides, documents, mockups, and other visual artifacts with Anthropic colors and typography.

faq.question: Does it include logo files?
faq.answer: No. It provides color, typography, and styling guidance, but it does not include logo assets.

faq.question: Which fonts does it recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends Poppins for headings and Lora for body text, with Arial and Georgia fallbacks.

faq.question: Can it modify files automatically?
faq.answer: Only if the host assistant has suitable file editing tools and the user asks for changes.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: No. The skill text does not require network access to apply the guidelines.

faq.question: Is this a complete brand governance package?
faq.answer: No. It is a compact styling reference, not a complete legal or governance policy.
